entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. This is a recorded line for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Yes, hi. I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I ordered. The website said it was backordered, but I wanted to know when I can expect it.
Thank you for calling, I'm happy to look into that for you. Just give me your order number or phone number associated with the order, please.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up. Alright, I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse. It is currently backordered. The estimated shipping time is approximately...90 days.
90 days? Great! So, I can expect it in about three months. Fantastic!
Actually, I apologize. I'm seeing here that the initial estimate I gave you was incorrect. The estimated shipping time is closer to 120 days. I am so sorry for that misstatement.
What? 90 days is what you just said! You just promised me 90 days! Are you kidding me? This is completely unacceptable!
I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the error. I know how frustrating it is when shipping times change. Let me see what I can do. You're a VIP Platinum member, correct?

Yes, I am! And I expect to be treated accordingly. I feel like this is a bait and switch. I saw the product advertised, ordered it, and now you're telling me it'll take even longer? Is VeloFit lying to its customers?

Sir, I can assure you that VeloFit is not lying to you. We value your business, especially as a Platinum member. Due to your loyalty status and the inconvenience this has caused, I am going to override the system. I can get the VeloBand Pulse shipped to you within the 90 days I initially stated. It will take some maneuvering on my part, but I can make it happen because of your commitment to VeloFit.
Really? You can do that? I was so looking forward to using it.

Yes, sir. I've already put in the request. It will take a day or two to process, but you should receive a confirmation email within 48 hours with the adjusted shipping date. Again, I sincerely apologize for the initial miscommunication. I should have checked the details more thoroughly before I gave you a definitive timeline.
Well, okay. If you promised me that, and it’s shipping within 90 days, I'm satisfied. Thank you.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that will be all. Thank you for your help.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
